findings.text: The new condition creates a gap for Node versions 14.17.0 through 14.x: on M1 Macs, these versions will not fall back to x64 architecture, but arm64 binaries don't exist for this range (only available from v16), causing installation failure. For example, VERSION=14.18.0 on darwin_arm64 will skip the x64 fallback and attempt to download a non-existent arm64 binary.
